types.description: GV3-A02 right-side auxiliary contact block, 2 NO early-break, for GV3ME

document.title: TeSys circuit-breakers — Thermal-magnetic motor circuit-breakers type GV3-ME
document.revision: Undated historical Schneider Electric / Telemecanique catalog excerpt

modelingNotes: Historical exact scheme uses GV3-A02; later manufacturer datasheet uses GV3A02. See https://iportal.se.com/Contents/docs/SQD-GV3A02.PDF (September 1, 2016, p.1) for identity, right-side mounting and screw-clamp data.

Exact GV3-A02 scheme verifies NO contacts 13–14 and 23–24 with mechanical linkage. Both open at host OFF and closed at ON. Early-break wording is retained from the product sheet; host-relative timing/travel is not expressible in this model. This is not a fault-only signaling block.

The historical ordering table prints GV1-A02, and the product photograph appears to show an NC pair. Neither is used for numbering; the explicitly labeled GV3-A02 schematic controls the modeled terminals.

All four passive terminals are application-dependent. No permanent internal links; contact and mechanical relation metadata do not merge nets. No host breaker poles or optional accessories are included.

Ui 690 V IEC / 600 V UL and CSA; Ith 6 A; Ue 48–690 V AC and 24–220 V DC are capabilities, not assigned nominal voltages. Conditional AC-11/DC-11 switching powers at 100,000 operations are preserved in research.md; no scalar terminal rating is assigned.
Screw clamps accept one or two solid 1–2.5 mm² conductors; flexible 0.75–2.5 mm², except two ferruled conductors 0.75–1.5 mm². Physical terminal orientation is not inferred.

connectionCoverage.notes: Four screw-clamp contact terminals 13, 14, 23, 24 established by the exact GV3-A02 schematic and product sheet. No additional supply, return, PE, shield, communication or spare terminal is documented for this passive auxiliary block. Host and other accessories are separate.
